The '''Dim-U monastery''' was a monastery located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It masqueraded as a monastery full of [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] monks, but only a few of its residents were actually devout. The majority of them were involved in a highly illegal venture, organized by the [[abbot]], [[Drayk]], to alter the [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder codes]] and emission signatures of ships to avoid identification. This service was typically used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] or the new owners of stolen ships. The building was a former greenhouse and was chosen for its low rent and location near the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] office.<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref> The pilot [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]] was employed to bring ships there for alterations, and several [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw techs]] performed the actual modifications.<ref name="At the Crossroads">{{StoryCite|story=At the Crossroads: The Spacer's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
